note: Written with SI assistance (Claude Code), reviewed by the team.
what: Official flood zones (SNCZI) against the observed flood (Copernicus EMS) per municipality.
method: Municipalities: IGN INSPIRE administrative units, fetched by id.

Official zones: SNCZI fluvial T10, T100, T500 and marine T100, T500 from the MITECO WFS, clipped to the municipalities. Each spot gets the most frequent zone it lies in: frequent (T10), occasional (T100), rare (T500 only), none (outside every zone).

Observed flood: flooded area plus flood traces of Copernicus EMS, as the maximum observed extent (a spot counts if any product saw water or a trace there). 2024: EMSR773, the three first-response products that map these towns (AOI03 grading v2, AOI03 delineation v1, AOI01 delineation v1); the priority mosaic (sharpest map first, where it looked) is given as the lower bound under sensitivity. 2026: EMSR935 as in data/labels.
Graded buildings (2024): the building points of the AOI03 grading map, each with the zone class of its point.

Areas: exact geometries in UTM 30N (EPSG:32630), GEOS overlay (snapped to a 1 cm grid only where GEOS reports a topology error). Shares are of the observed flood inside each municipality. Web layers are simplified copies for display only; their area_ha comes from the exact geometries.
No estimate without a label: a share is null where nothing was observed.

classes.frequent: frequent: T10 zone (high probability, 1 in 10 each year)
classes.occasional: occasional: T100 zone, not T10 (medium probability, 1 in 100 each year)
classes.rare: rare: only the T500 zone (low probability, 1 in 500 each year)

claims.claim: the 2024 DANA flooded 14 % outside every zone
claims.our_number: SNCZI, 10 municipalities: 46.0 % of the observed flood outside every zone (2418.0 of 5253.9 ha); 31.8 % with the sharpest map first (3232.6 ha); 60.8 % of the flood traces (streets); 58.0 % of the 2238 graded buildings
claims.cited_number: 14.1 % outside MIPICOVA (PATRICOVA plus SNCZI) in three whole basins (Camarasa-Belmonte et al. 2025)
claims.threshold: holds if our numbers are within 3 points of 14 %
claims.say: With the national flood map (SNCZI), 32 to 46 % of the land the 2024 DANA flooded in these 10 towns was outside every official flood zone. The 14 % figure is real but belongs to a different map and area: 14.1 % of the area flooded in the Poyo, Magro and Albufera ravine basins was outside the Valencian integrated hazard map MIPICOVA (Camarasa-Belmonte et al. 2025).

sources.citation: Camarasa-Belmonte, A., Zornoza-Gallego, C., Sanchis-Ibor, C., Serrano-Lara, J.J. (2025). ¿Cómo de efectiva es la cartografía de peligro de inundación para la gestión de la emergencia? Evaluación a partir del mapa de las inundaciones de Valencia de octubre de 2024. Ingeniería del Agua 29(4), 229-244
sources.numbers: Table 1: 37,972.1 ha flooded in the Poyo-Poçalet-Saleta, Magro and Albufera ravine basins; 5,353.5 ha (14.1 %) outside the hazard map MIPICOVA (PATRICOVA plus SNCZI, with the geomorphological level); Poyo-Poçalet-Saleta 20.5 %, Magro 20.8 %, Albufera ravines 5.4 %

claims.claim: Paiporta and Massanassa were almost all rare
claims.our_number: Paiporta: land 40.7 % only rare, 55.5 % outside every zone, 3.8 % frequent or occasional; flood traces 40.9 % only rare; graded buildings 45.3 % only rare, 54.7 % outside (of 327); Massanassa: land 49.7 % only rare, 5.5 % outside every zone, 44.8 % frequent or occasional; flood traces 79.7 % only rare; graded buildings 96.0 % only rare, 4.0 % outside (of 199)
claims.threshold: almost all = at least 90 % of the graded (affected) buildings only in the rare (T500) zone; the elDiario.es source of the claim counted buildings
claims.say: Massanassa, yes: 96 % of its affected buildings were in the rare zone. Paiporta, no: 45 % of its affected buildings were in the rare zone and 55 % outside every zone; of its flooded land 41 % was rare and 56 % outside. Massanassa's standing water (263 ha, 76 % in the frequent or occasional zones) lay on cropland and wetland of the Albufera (74 % and 22 % in ESA WorldCover), not in the town.

sources.citation: Miguel Giménez, 'El riesgo de inundación en los municipios de la zona cero de la DANA en Valencia era muy bajo', elDiario.es, 8 Jan 2025
sources.numbers: Dwellings (Catastro) in SNCZI zones, not flooded area: Massanassa 100 % of buildings in the 500-year zone and 0.1 % in the 100-year zone; Paiporta about 3,500 dwellings in the 500-year zone and 3 in the 100-year zone; Sedaví with no risk in the 500-year map

claims.our_number: Sedaví: 91.4 % of its flooded land outside every zone (96.0 % of its flood traces), 99.5 % of its 196 graded buildings; official zones cover 7.2 % of the municipality
claims.threshold: holds if at least 95 % of the affected buildings and of the flood traces were outside every zone; partly if at least 80 %
claims.say: Sedaví: 99.5 % of its affected buildings and 91 % of the land that flooded were outside every official flood zone (zones cover only 7 % of the town's area, so not literally none).
